name: F#
summary: Functional-first, strongly typed ML-family language for .NET with type inference, discriminated unions, pattern matching, computation expressions, units of measure and type providers; also compiles to JavaScript via Fable.

level_notes.0: dotnet/fsharp holds the only full compiler (fsc/fsi, FSharp.Compiler.Service) and FSharp.Core. Pipeline: lex.fsl -> LexFilter (offside rule) -> pars.fsy -> SyntaxTree -> Checking (type inference, constraint solving) -> TypedTree -> Optimizer -> IlxGen -> AbstractIL writer. Fable reuses the front end and emits JavaScript and other targets.
level_notes.1: The F# Language Specification (community-maintained at fsharp.github.io/fslang-spec, continuing the F# 4.1 PDF) is the normative text; features added since 4.1 are specified by fslang-design RFCs, and the Microsoft Learn language reference is the official reference manual. No ISO/ECMA standard.
